failures.criterion: 6 (real surface, with a deployment `instructions:` file configured) — the gate policy does not reach the root architect; found on the real surface at 62d8f447
failures.evidence: This head's scripts/smoke/up.sh writes `instructions:` into legion.yaml, so every pane receives THREE --append-system-prompt fragments (role prompt, addressing + 'Design gate policy: gates.design: root-issues …', deployment instructions). The real architect (root LEGSMOKE-1, run A) skipped the gate — no dispatch_request_approval, no register_gate, spawned an implementer directly — and its session record reasons: 'the gate policy line isn't visible at the end of my system prompt … there's no explicit Design gate policy statement before the deployment instructions … I'm also uncertain whether I'm the architect or controller here'. The pane argv carries the line (panes-argv.txt). Root cause, proven: OMP's --append-system-prompt is last-wins — the binary's handler is `"--append-system-prompt": (e, s) => { e.appendSystemPrompt = s; }`; a one-shot `omp -p` with three marked fragments answers only FRAGMENT_CHARLIE and with two only FRAGMENT_BRAVO, on both github:sjawhar/oh-my-pi@18.1.18-sami.20260912-203541 (production panes) and 18.1.18-sami.20260912-104423 (repository pin). Consequences: the daemon's role prompt has never reached a spawned pane on these builds; with `instructions:` configured (production LEGION is) only the deployment instructions reach the model — this tester's own production-spawned system prompt has the deployment instructions and neither the '# Legion Tester' role text nor the 'Legion addressing' line. Acceptance 6's daemon test (the argv fragment) passes; the real surface does not. Architect ruling 2026-09-13 05:31Z: the daemon joins all fragments into ONE --append-system-prompt (processes.ts, in this PR); production impact escalated to the controller. Items a–f were therefore run on a rig variant whose legion.yaml omits `instructions:` (two fragments; the addressing+policy fragment is last and reaches the architect — the round 1–2 configuration). Raw: runA-instructions-fragment/ in the round-3 bundle.

notProven: Acceptance 6 live WITH `instructions:` configured after the join fix (next round per the architect: single --append-system-prompt in the pane argv; architect session shows role prompt, addressing + policy, and deployment instructions; a real armed-gate architect requests and registers).

The production daemon's own OMP binary /home/ubuntu/.local/state/legion/sjawhar-legion/omp/omp-18.1.15-sami.9bff2014-rpcfix was not probed for the flag behaviour (production panes observed running 18.1.18-sami.20260912-203541, which was).
